cases.observed: Generic event waiter timeout at core/tests/common/lib.rs:356:14 after 10.326 seconds; the original block has no caller backtrace or event trace.

source_chain.fact: wait_for_exec_approval_request returns Some(request) on ExecApprovalRequest and None only on TurnComplete; no other event satisfies the predicate.

wait_for_event_match consumes the event through wait_for_event; when the matching event is normal TurnComplete, the common waiter also observes the exact pending normal finish owner under its existing event deadline.

The test asserts approval.is_none(), proving the matching completion was consumed on any path that reaches the following wait_for_turn_complete; it then waits for another completion without submitting another turn.

cases.classification: Deterministic redundant wait on the no-approval success path. The source establishes why this path cannot complete normally; the terse observed panic is consistent but does not itself identify the waiter call site.
cases.repair: Remove only the second completion wait and explain that the no-approval branch already consumed it. Preserve the approval-is-none assertion and all three output/filesystem security assertions.
cases.preserved: Granular approval fields, script bytes, declared write metadata, real shell intercept runtime, same command, same restrictive workspace profile, all existing wait budgets, responses and single-request output checks.
cases.helper_scope: The local approval waiter has one call site. The separate wait_for_turn_complete helper remains used by the other test in this source file.

cases.observed: Session initialization fails while loading AGENTS.md, before model requests or parent approval: bubblewrap rejects an unreadable glob whose reported value is an absolute secret.env path without glob metacharacters.

source_chain.fact: The test creates a real absolute temporary secret.env file, inserts that exact path as a deny TOML key, and builds the session with this profile.

Its private permission_profile_from_toml helper unconditionally maps every Deny entry to FileSystemPath::GlobPattern. Full-file references show this helper is used only by denied_read_permission_profile, which is used only by this test.

Literal paths and glob patterns are distinct runtime variants. AbsolutePathBuf converts to the literal Path variant. Denied literal paths are returned as unreadable roots; only GlobPattern entries are returned as unreadable globs.
Glob expansion requires a first glob metacharacter. The exact file has none, so split_pattern_for_ripgrep returns None and expansion returns the exact fatal message observed in the original failure.
The production config compiler already sends keys with no glob metacharacters through literal absolute-path compilation, instead of manufacturing a GlobPattern.
Existing sandbox unit coverage expresses an exact denied file as AbsolutePathBuf.into() and checks the unreadable file mask. It was inspected as source, not run in this review.

cases.classification: Incorrect private fixture translation of a literal path, not a production authorization or glob-expansion failure.
cases.repair: For the fixture helper's only Deny input, validate AbsolutePathBuf::from_absolute_path(path) and convert to the existing literal runtime Path representation. Preserve Deny, root Read, project-root Write, network Restricted, missing-path behavior and glob depth.
cases.preserved: Original secret bytes and location, explicit has_denied_read_restrictions assertion, parent-approval command and flow, nonzero exit-code assertion, secret non-disclosure assertion, existing parser rejection of unsupported entries. Production glob fail-closed behavior is unchanged.

environment_boundary: The shared zsh-fork test runtime already sets allow_login_shell=false. Neither candidate changes shell/login behavior, DotSlash fetching, native environment, sandbox escape or permissions. These causes do not rely on the prior login-profile stderr attribution.
